title: Three-Parted
summary: THREE'-P'ARTED, adjective [three and parted.] Tripartite. A three-parted leaf, is divided into three parts down to the base, but not entirely separate. THREE'-PENCE, noun thrip'ence. [three and pence.

inlines.v: THREE'-P'ARTED, adjective [three and parted.] Tripartite. A three-parted leaf, is divided into three parts down to the base, but not entirely separate. THREE'-PENCE, noun thrip'ence. [three and pence.] A small silver coin of three times the value of a penny. THREE'-PENNY, adjective thrip'enny. Worth three pence only; mean.
